results.transcription: i received a damaged product what is your return and refund policy
results.response_text:
Hello, I’m ZentroMart’s AI support assistant. For a damaged item you can initiate a return within the return window that applies to the product’s category (see RET‑2).  
- The return window starts on the delivery date and is counted in calendar days.  
- Once you return the item, we pick it up and it goes through a quality check (QC).  
- For a standard‑member, the refund is initiated within 2 business days of pickup (RET‑7).  
- For ZentroMart Plus members, the refund is initiated at the time of pickup.  
- After initiation, the refund is credited to the original payment method according to the timelines in REF‑2 (e.g., 1‑3 business days for UPI, 5‑7 business days for cards, instant for ZentroMart Wallet, etc.).  

If the item’s value exceeds ₹10,000, the claim is handled by the Priority Resolution team and a ticket must be created (DWM‑3).  

To start the process, please provide your order number and the product category (or let us know the item’s value if it’s above ₹10,000). Once we have that, we can arrange the pickup and proceed with the refund.

retrieved_sources.title: Returns policy
retrieved_sources.text:
## [RET-7] After pickup
Returned items go through a quality check (QC) at the warehouse. The refund is initiated within 2 business days of pickup once the item passes QC. For ZentroMart Plus members, the refund is initiated at the time of pickup. Refund timelines after initiation are in the Refunds policy.

retrieved_sources.title: Refunds policy
retrieved_sources.text:
## [REF-2] How long refunds take after initiation
Refunds go back to the original payment method. Timelines are counted in business days from the day the refund is initiated.

| Payment method | Time to reach you |
| --- | --- |
| UPI | 1 to 3 business days |
| Credit or debit card | 5 to 7 business days |
| Net banking | 3 to 5 business days |
| ZentroMart Wallet | Instant, within 2 hours |
| Bank transfer (NEFT) for cash-on-delivery orders | 5 to 7 business days |
| ZentroMart Wallet for cash-on-delivery orders | Instant, within 2 hours |

retrieved_sources.title: Returns policy
retrieved_sources.text:
## [RET-2] Return windows by category
The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. The category of every product is listed in the `return_category` column of the product catalog.

| Category | Return window | Catalog code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Electronics and accessories | 7 days | `electronics` |
| Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | `fashion` |
| Home, kitchen and furniture | 10 days | `home_kitchen` |
| Beauty and personal care (unopened, seal intact) | 7 days | `beauty_sealed` |
| Books and stationery | 10 days | `books_media` |
| Grocery, fresh and perishables | Not returnable | `grocery` |
| Innerwear, lingerie and swimwear | Not returnable | `innerwear` |
| Gift cards and digital codes | Not returnable | `digital` |

retrieved_sources.title: Refunds policy
retrieved_sources.text:
## [REF-1] When a refund is initiated
- **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation.
- **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup.
- **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.

retrieved_sources.title: Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
retrieved_sources.text:
## [DWM-3] High-value items
Claims for items worth more than ₹10,000 are handled by the Priority Resolution team. The support agent must create a ticket and hand over; the agent cannot approve these claims.

retrieved_sources.title: Escalation and human handover
retrieved_sources.text:
## [ESC-1] When to hand over to a human
Hand over at once when any of these is true:

1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.**
2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.**
3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.**
4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.**
5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.**
6. **Customer asks for a human agent.**
7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.**

For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more.

## [RVP-2] Missed pickup
If the executive does not arrive, the pickup is rescheduled automatically to the next business day. After two missed pickups, the customer can ask support to raise a priority pickup.

retrieved_sources.text:
## [PAY-4] ZentroMart Wallet
ZentroMart Wallet balance can be used on any order and never expires. It cannot be transferred to a bank account. For cash-on-delivery refunds, the customer chooses Wallet or bank transfer before the refund is made (REF-3); once refunded to the Wallet, it stays there.
